page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.m1 server family. Built on the KVM hypervisor, this instance utilizes the x86_64 CPU architecture. It is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 4 physical cores, resulting in a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. The system is equipped with 16.0 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring external network-attached block storage for all data persistence. It contains no GPU hardware and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The underlying CPU architecture lacks support for advanced instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), cryptographic acceleration (AES, SHA), and bit manipulation instructions (BMI2, FMA).

The dedicated CPU allocation model ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing predictable execution times. However, the lack of hyperthreading and modern vector instruction sets limits its efficiency for highly parallelized or mathematically intensive workloads. The hardware profile is structured for standard enterprise utilities, web serving, and application hosting where specialized hardware acceleration is unnecessary.
